title: MOCHI health policy, mochi-health-policy-v1
description: The policy file `mochi health --policy FILE.json` reads (mochi_core::health::HealthPolicy; docs/c14-cli.md rule 13). An input, not an output: a file the CLI refuses (exit 3, INVALID_ARGUMENT) fails this schema, and a file this schema accepts is accepted. A dimension listed twice counts once. Frozen with R7 (gate G15); a change is a new schema string.

max_age_days.description: A kind named here is required to have evidence at most this many days old; a kind not named has no age limit and is not required.
